warmup.description: Gradually increase heart rate and prepare for light interval changes in pace.
movements: Easy walk or cycle x 3 minutes
Gradual pace increase to light effort x 2 minutes

main_exercises.name: Light Interval Cardio (Alternating Effort)
main_exercises.load_guidance: Alternate between zone 2 (60-70% effort) for 2 minutes and zone 3 (70-75% effort) for 1 minute, maintaining control and avoiding breathlessness
main_exercises.form_cue: During higher effort intervals, slightly increase pace while keeping breathing controlled and posture relaxed

cooldown.description: Bring heart rate down gradually and return to a relaxed state.
movements: Slow walk or easy cycle x 3 minutes

phase_notes.menstrual: Keep intervals gentle and shorten higher-effort segments if needed—focus on maintaining a comfortable rhythm rather than pushing pace.
phase_notes.follicular: Great phase to engage with light intervals—slightly increase pace during higher-effort segments while staying controlled.
phase_notes.ovulatory: You may feel capable of pushing harder, but keep intervals moderate and avoid turning this into a high-intensity session.
phase_notes.early_luteal: Maintain steady effort and avoid overreaching—focus on smooth transitions between effort levels.
phase_notes.late_luteal: Reduce intensity of higher-effort intervals if needed—keep the session feeling manageable and focus on consistency over performance.
